No deviations from plan scope; both remaining beads (workspace-htgw header restructure, workspace-jzul Files tab) implemented, committed per-bead, pushed. All 9 pan-1232 beads now closed. Full frontend suite green (189 files / 1756 tests), frontend tsc + eslint clean.

Verified deviations from bead wording (root-cause, not bandaids — all documented in commit bodies):

1. Branch field. The header bead said activeAgent.branchName, but no branchName field exists on the Agent type. The branch lives at agent.git?.branch (GitStatus.branch) — how every other frontend surface reads it (CommandPalette, GodView/AgentCard, FocusView). Used the verified-correct field.

2. Radius token. Header AC6 named var(--radius-md), but that CSS variable is undefined in the codebase (only --radius and --radius-sm exist as CSS vars; --radius-lg is referenced elsewhere but also resolves to nothing). The medium radius lives in the Tailwind theme (tailwind.config.js: md = calc(var(--radius) - 2px)), so the branch chip uses rounded-md — the working medium-radius primitive matching the AC's intent.

3. formatSpend reused by exporting it from DrawerActiveAgent (bead's first-listed option) instead of duplicating.

4. Files tab. DiffPanel has no 'files-only'/'compact' CONTENT mode (its modes are layout-only inline|sheet|sidebar), so the full inline DiffPanel is rendered per the bead's 'otherwise render the full DiffPanel'. DiffPanel is agent-scoped (it calls /api/agents/:id/diffs), so the Files tab scopes to the issue's canonical work agent via pickDefaultDrawerAgent — no new server endpoint added (AC4). Added an initial-fetch 'Loading files…' gate mirroring the standalone diff popout to avoid a misleading 'No completed turns yet' flash.

Minor: commitlint emits a non-blocking scope-enum warning (scope 'drawer' vs allowed list) on both commits; commits landed fine. Amending is forbidden, so left as-is.

# Review CHANGES REQUESTED for PAN-1232

# Review Synthesis — PAN-1232 — 2026-07-12T17:49:10-04:00

## Verdict: CHANGES REQUESTED — Files tab renders blank on the main path and six in-scope acceptance criteria remain unmet

## Context
- Manifest: /home/eltmon/Projects/overdeck/workspaces/feature-pan-1232/.pan/review/agent-pan-1232-review-63ca56ef/context.json

## Convoy Status
| Sub-role | Signal | Output | Blocking findings |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| security | ready | /home/eltmon/Projects/overdeck/workspaces/feature-pan-1232/.pan/review/agent-pan-1232-review-63ca56ef/security.md | 0 |
| correctness | ready | /home/eltmon/Projects/overdeck/workspaces/feature-pan-1232/.pan/review/agent-pan-1232-review-63ca56ef/correctness.md | 1 |
| performance | ready | /home/eltmon/Projects/overdeck/workspaces/feature-pan-1232/.pan/review/agent-pan-1232-review-63ca56ef/performance.md | 0 |
| requirements | ready | /home/eltmon/Projects/overdeck/workspaces/feature-pan-1232/.pan/review/agent-pan-1232-review-63ca56ef/requirements.md | 6 |

## Blocking Findings

### [correctness] Files tab renders blank because `DiffPanel` is URL-gated — `src/dashboard/frontend/src/components/drawer/IssueDrawer.tsx:185`
`DrawerFilesPanel` mounts `<DiffPanel mode="inline" agentId={agentId} turnDiffSummaries={diffData?.summaries ?? []} />`, but `DiffPanel` returns `null` unless `urlParams.diff === '1'`. Normal navigation to `drawer.tab === 'files'` does not set `diff=1`, so after the diff-summary query resolves the Files tab can become blank instead of showing the branch-vs-main diff. The fix should make inline embedding explicitly open, or initialize the required diff URL state before mounting `DiffPanel`, without relying on unrelated global URL state.

### [requirements] Plan-tab HTTP errors render as an empty plan instead of the required error line — `src/dashboard/frontend/src/components/drawer/IssueDrawer.tsx:76`
Scope: in_pr_scope. AC-17 requires failed plan fetches to render a 12px muted error line while empty plans delegate to `VBriefViewer`. `DrawerPlanPanel` returns `null` for non-OK HTTP responses, leaving `isError` false and rendering `VBriefViewer doc={null}` instead of the error line.

### [requirements] Plan tab can refetch on tab remount because no `staleTime` is configured — `src/dashboard/frontend/src/components/drawer/IssueDrawer.tsx:72`
Scope: in_pr_scope. AC-18 requires switching away from the plan tab and back not to refetch within the expected React Query freshness window. The plan panel unmounts when inactive and its `useQuery` options do not configure `staleTime`, so remounting can refetch and flicker.

### [requirements] Conversation empty state uses 13px text, not required 12px text — `src/dashboard/frontend/src/components/drawer/DrawerAgentSession.tsx:140`
Scope: in_pr_scope. AC-22 requires a 12px muted empty state when no active agent exists for the conversation tab. The shared no-agent branch renders `text-[13px] leading-6 text-muted-foreground`.

### [requirements] Terminal empty state uses 13px text, not required 12px text — `src/dashboard/frontend/src/components/drawer/DrawerAgentSession.tsx:140`
Scope: in_pr_scope. AC-27 requires a 12px muted empty state when no active agent exists for the terminal tab. The same shared no-agent branch renders `text-[13px]`, so the terminal tab misses the specified typography.

### [requirements] Files tab does not render `DiffPanel` for a workspace branch unless an agent id is also present — `src/dashboard/frontend/src/components/drawer/IssueDrawer.tsx:174`
Scope: in_pr_scope. AC-34 requires the Files tab to render `DiffPanel` scoped to `feature/<issue-id>` vs `main` when a workspace branch exists. `DrawerFilesPanel` also requires `agentId`; if the workspace exists but `agentId` is null, it renders the empty state instead.

### [requirements] Branch chip radius does not use `var(--radius-md)` — `src/dashboard/frontend/src/components/drawer/IssueDrawer.tsx:335`
Scope: in_pr_scope. AC-6 requires the branch chip to use background `var(--accent)`, radius `var(--radius-md)`, and 12px muted text. The chip uses `rounded-md bg-accent px-[8px] py-[2px] text-[12px] text-muted-foreground`; only the radius token is noncompliant.

## Non-blocking Findings

### [performance] Avoid deriving the full activity list twice for the Activity tab — `src/dashboard/frontend/src/components/drawer/IssueDrawer.tsx:44`
The Activity tab calls `useDrawerData()` inside `DrawerActivityPanel()` while `IssueDrawer()` already calls the same hook for the issue. This repeats filtering, mapping, and sorting for the uncapped activity list. The performance reviewer classified this as non-blocking because the cost is small for typical issue activity, but recommended passing `activityFull` from the parent drawer instead.

### [requirements] Changed backlog route has no mapped requirement
The requirements reviewer noted that `src/dashboard/server/routes/backlog.ts` is in the changed-file set but no acceptance criterion, trace item, non-goal, or stub finding in the manifest maps to backlog sequence route behavior.

### [advisory] CodeRabbit nitpick
CodeRabbit suggested reusing the shared `isActiveAgent` helper in `IssueDrawer.tsx` instead of duplicating the active-agent predicate. This was advisory and non-gating in the review context.

## Clean Sub-roles
- security

Source: /home/eltmon/Projects/overdeck/workspaces/feature-pan-1232/.pan/review/agent-pan-1232-review-63ca56ef/synthesis.md

## Required action

Fix every blocking review finding, commit the fixes, then re-request review with:

`pan review request PAN-1232 -m "Fixed review issues"`
